{{Quote|Have you ever tasted my bantha cutlet with spicefruit reduction?|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Spicefruit''' was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] used in cooking. It could be prepared as a reduction and served with [[bantha cutlet]]. [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Voort saBinring]] once boasted his bantha cutlet with spicefruit reduction.<ref name="MK" />
